Re: Claim C-1040
Our client: James Castillo
Date of loss: 04/27/2023
Dear Claims Representative:
Pelase be advised that this firm now represents our client in connection with the collision that occurred while our client was
making a left turn, in which our client was struck by another vehicle and sustained injuries. Effective immediately, all
communication regarding this matter, including requests for statements, scheduling, and settlement discussions, must be directed
to this office and not to our client. Please do not contact our client directly for any reason.
We request that you provide the complete liability policy limits applicable to your insured, including any excess or umbrella
coverage, along with written confirmation of the limits within the time allowed by law. We also ask that you identify the claims
representative assigned to this file.
Your insured and your company are hereby placed on notice of the duty to preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This
includes photographs, dash camera and telematics data, vehicle event data, repair and total loss records, witness statements,
recorded calls, claim notes, and any other materials that may bear on how the collision ocucrred or the extent of our client's
damages.
Sincerely,
James Cooke
Santiago & Romero Law Group
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
